5150101.text: This Commercial Street bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices of all kinds will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

5150201.text: Former Tenryou Commissioner Kujou Takayuki has presently been relieved from his post. He faces charges of dereliction, corruption, endangering the nation and its people, among others, and is awaiting judgment.

5150202.text: Due to his age and in consideration of his accomplishments, he has been confined to his quarters indefinitely, and will not be released on bail.

5150203.text: If he commits any treasonous acts during this time, his judgment will be executed with great prejudice and without mercy.

5150204.text: While the Tenryou Commission discusses matters of reformation, its duties shall be performed by a personal deputy of Her Excellency.

5150205.text: There will be no adjustment in Doushin and Yoriki ranks. Overall command has been ceded to Madam Kujou Sara.

5150301.text: We urge all citizens to remain calm. The Tenryou Commission's stability and its management of Tenshukaku's defense are now in Madam Kujou Sara's capable hands.

5150302.text: Rest assured that Kujou Takayuki's militant brutality, forced seizure of Visions, and suppression of the citizenry is now being reversed post-haste!

5150303.text: "Hah! No wonder I couldn't find you anywhere, Kujou Tengu! Guess you're moving up in the world, huh!"

5150304.text: "Well alright then! Guess I'll just march right up to Tenshukaku's gates and challenge you to—"

5150305.text: (The words here cannot be made out, almost as if the person who wrote them suddenly had a fall. Or perhaps...)

5150306.text: The rude lout who has been harassing Madam Kujou Sara has been arrested. Please be at ease, citizens.

5150401.text: "I am currently seeking my foolish younger brother, Shikanoin Heizou. He names himself a detective and behaves arrogantly and disrespectfully."

5150402.text: "He has gone missing again in recent days — if anyone has seen or heard of him, please let me know about his whereabouts."

5150404.text: "He's gone off to investigate again, yes... I can only hope that no one else gets hurt in the process."

5150405.text: "...Oh, so you were just worried about other people, huh..."

5150501.text: "Thanks to your aid and support, Ogura Textiles & Kimonos has weathered the worst of this storm."

5150502.text: "Word is that the Kanjou Commission is currently negotiating with Liyue's mercantile guilds and that the import of silks and ready-to-wear clothes will soon resume..."

5150503.text: "Once my brother returns from his duties, we shall refurbish this store together."

5150504.text: "Once again, I, Ogura Mio, would like to thank all our neighbors and friends for lending a helping hand. I will find a way to repay you all in turn."

5150505.text: "No, no, it was what we should've done. You're too polite, Miss Ogura!"

5150506.text: "Well, the war's over in any case, so don't mind if I engage your services again the next time I need a custom-made kimono!"

5150601.text: Citizens of Inazuma, please stay alert while traveling at night. A monster in the form of a tanuki has been spotted around the city lately.

5150602.text: This monster appears to be infant-sized. It moves very quickly and is quite fierce!

5150603.text: Please report to a nearby Doushin or to the Tenryou Commission upon seeing it!

5150604.text: "I've told you, it's not a tanuki! Not a tanuki! Not. A. Tanuki. You hear!?"

5150605.text: "It's a mujina! A. Mujina! How many times do I have to say this!?"

5150702.text: Ah, to think that I was not present to receive such fine guests from faraway Watatsumi. You have my most sincere apologies for my failings.

5150703.text: "Uh, wow, that's kinda formal... How am I supposed to reply?"

5150704.text: "Eh, you can just take that to be the Narukami way. All roundabout and longwinded-like, not like us Watatsumi folk!"

5150705.text: What that guy above means is: None of my business.

5150801.text: I'm searching for my husband, Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. He is a tall man without any facial hair and has a scar on the side of his forehead. He has yet to return home despite the ceasefire.

5150802.text: If any returning samurai or old friends and acquaintances know of his whereabouts, please inform me. You will be duly thanked for your help!

5150901.text: Returning, demobilized samurai can report to the Yashiro Commission estates to receive subsidies and indicate their preferred avenues of future employment.

5150902.text: Additionally, the Grand Narukami Shrine will hold sharing sessions for samurai who took part in the war and their families to help heal the traumas caused by the war.

5150903.text: "Thank you, Lady Miko, for your painstaking efforts, but I fear that some of our hurts may never be healed."

5150904.text: It is "companionship" that gives "eternity" meaning. The past may have been cruel, but the future shall be longer still.

5150905.text: It is alright to harbor inescapable hurts, for in this, no one is forever alone.

5150906.text: In my own name and that of the Grand Narukami Shrine, I, Yae Miko, await your arrival.

5151001.text: "They say that the insanely talented author from Liyue, Zhenyu, is also a chivalrous hero."

5151002.text: "Ever since I read one of his books, I've always wondered what sort of person he might be."

5151003.text: "Don't think about it too much. Maybe he's just like most authors from Inazuma. You know the type: some sickly, thin, glasses-wearing middle-aged man."

5151004.text: "He could also be some rotund scholar who speaks weirdly and stuff, you know..."

5151005.text: "You know what I think? I think he's got to be some mountain of martial muscle! A powerful body and a sharp mind, all rolled into one!"

5151006.text: "You're all wrong! I mean, just look at that lovely handwriting! It's gotta be a beautiful young woman, one who knows her way around books and scholarly tomes of all kinds!"

5151007.text: Please control yourselves! This is a public notice board, not someplace to endlessly jabber about personal matters!

5151101.text: "The Kamisato siblings of the Yashiro Commission have been in higher spirits lately."

5151102.text: "It seems that the recent changes have seen the Kamisato Clan's prestige grow significantly. I suppose that's the unpredictability of life for you, huh?"

5151103.text: "Ah, are you feeling a little sour about our Commissioner's rise, my friend?"

5151104.text: "No, no, I wouldn't dare... I'm just saying that it's going to be tough times for the other two major Commissions."

5151201.text: "We fought to the death against the folks from Sangonomiya, and now we need to rebuild an island together with them..."

5151202.text: "I mean, I know that it's an arrangement that comes down from the top and that everyone acknowledges that this is the right thing to do, but it just leaves a bitter taste in my mouth, you know?"

5151203.text: The time for peace has come, so don't think about it too much. Our cooperation now is also meant to build a better nation for future generations.

5151301.text: Due to revisions in relations with Sangonomiya, Tatarasuna has temporarily ceased production of Jade Steel.

5151302.text: All smiths, please take note that logistics and transportation departments will not carry Jade Steel or any products derived from it.

5151401.text: "The previous Clan Head was remiss in his duties, resulting in a crisis for the clan. But thanks to the Shogun's clemency, the clan was spared capital punishment."

5151402.text: "As such, we retainers of the Kujou Clan have in turn been spared the agony of watching this venerable house's extinction. We must redouble our efforts from this day forth to atone for our failures..."

5151403.text: "We must support Young Masters Kujou Kamaji and Kujou Masahito in setting our affairs in order and in defending the reign of our Almighty Shogun."

5151501.text: "I, Tatsunosuke, have found a new hobby after closing my military strategy dojo for good!"

5151502.text: "My grandson has introduced me to Mr. Hiratsuka of the Yae Publishing House. Starting today, I'm a contracted writer, too!"

5151503.text: "My pen name shall be Houjou Noriko. I look forward to working with you all!"

5151504.text: "Uh, Master... Can I ask why you've chosen to use a lady's name?"
